name: Franklin County, AR
findings: Franklin County has 31 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (16%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, Franklin County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Franklin County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 64% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
